page: TypeBox schema (Elysia.t) for validation. Common patterns for types. Primitive types: String, Number, Boolean, Array, Object, Null, Literal. Basic TypeBox API similar to TypeScript. Runtime type validation. Type attributes: format, minimum, maximum, minItems, maxItems, additionalProperties. Union types for multiple types. Optional fields. Partial for all optional. Honorable mentions: Union, Optional, Partial. Elysia types: UnionEnum, File, Files, Cookie, Nullable, MaybeEmpty, Form, UInt8Array, ArrayBuffer, ObjectString, BooleanString, Numeric. Elysia behavior: Optional, Number to Numeric conversion, Boolean to BooleanString conversion.

sections.manifest: Primitive types TypeScript-like. String, Number, Boolean, Array, Object, Null, Literal values. Attribute configuration JSON Schema 7. Format email. Minimum/maximum ranges. MinItems/maxItems array limits. AdditionalProperties object behavior.
Honorable mentions patterns. Union for multiple types. Optional for undefined-able fields. Partial for all optional object fields.

Elysia types extensions. UnionEnum for value set. File singular with type, minSize, maxSize. Files array of files. Cookie object-like with secrets, sign. Nullable null-only. MaybeEmpty null/undefined. Form FormData syntax sugar. UInt8Array buffer parsing. ArrayBuffer buffer parsing. ObjectString string parsing. BooleanString string boolean. Numeric numeric string conversion. MaybeEmpty union null undefined.

Elysia type behavior differences. Optional field makes optional. Number becomes Numeric in route schema. Boolean becomes BooleanString in route schema. Not converted in nested Object. HTTP headers/query/params always strings.
Optional field makes optional in route schema. Allows skipped query parameters. Different from TypeBox where marks object field optional.
Number to Numeric automatic conversion. Route schema with Number converted to Numeric. Nested t.Object not converted. Handles string numbers in URL.
Boolean to BooleanString conversion. Route schema Boolean becomes BooleanString. Nested not converted. Handles string booleans in query.
